payload.title: analytics chart renders weekly traffic
payload.errorMessage:
Timed out 10000ms waiting for expect(locator).toBeVisible()

Locator: getByTestId('analytics-chart-canvas')
Expected: visible
Received: <element(s) not found>

note: A chart canvas that never renders looks like a client-side rendering bug — bad data silently crashing the chart library — but failedRequests shows the weekly-analytics endpoint returning 503 on the reported attempt. The chart component correctly renders nothing because it never received data to draw, not because it mishandled data it did receive.
